source_evidence: D327~15:39 exact player 'That sounds agreeable' expresses approval of Tavosk's tentative 6gp first-notice price. It does not explicitly authorize handing over coins, ordering a particular warning, actual shipment, signature, or continuing commitment. Tavosk interprets V as an interested prospective client, says 'Good. Six gold for the first notice, then. Would you like to commission it now, or shall we wait until you have a consignment in mind?' He is willing to proceed on a separate actual instruction and payment, but no payment received, service commissioned, inspection identified, warning delivered, or document created. V controls consequential spending; stop before it. Mara, Cirren and Fenar hear the exchange. No check, feature use, new disclosure of Watch evidence, new actor or Harthvale reply. All counters and custody unchanged.
